rows.note: Use this when someone fusses over wording, technicalities, or trivial points rather than the main issue.

example.english: Being so pedantic about wording, no one cares about your main point.
example.traditional: 咁樣咬文嚼字，根本冇人理你個重點。
example.jyutping: gam3 joeng2 ngaau5 man4 zoek3 zi6 gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 lei5 nei5 go3 zung6 dim2

rows.note: Use this for pedantry that is old-fashioned, rigid, and overly tied to formal rules rather than specifically to wording.

example.english: This pedantic set of rules has long been out of date.
example.traditional: 呢套迂腐嘅規矩，早就唔合時宜喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 jyu1 fu6 ge3 kwai1 geoi2 zou2 zau6 m4 hap6 si4 ji4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone shows off what they know in an annoying or tiresome way.

example.english: They are so pedantic, showing off their knowledge over dinner until nobody wants to speak.
example.traditional: 佢食餐飯都要賣弄學問，講到人人都唔想出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sik6 caan1 faan6 dou1 jiu3 maai6 lung6 hok6 man6 gong2 dou3 jan4 jan4 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 seng1
